Ravi: Heads up — seeing output divergence after ~11.2k tokens on the magnet16k int4 bring-up when streaming + prefetch are enabled. Repro is pretty reliable here.
Maya: Can you drop the minimal repro command and a short log snippet?
Ravi: Repro command: `rbx run --model magnet16k --quant int4 --streaming --prefetch --input-file long_prompt.txt`
Ravi: Log excerpt:```
[2025-03-12T14:03:21Z] kv_prefetch: window=2048 start=9216
[2025-03-12T14:03:21Z] kv_index_mismatch: expected 0x1a3 got 0x1a2 at pos 11262
[2025-03-12T14:03:21Z] attn_norm_pre=0.9872 attn_norm_post=0.9531
```
Devon: Is this with kv-sharding enabled or single-shard? which kernel?
Ravi: Single-GPU (shard=1) for the initial repro. kernel=fused_attn_v2.
Maya: Interesting. Does the issue disappear with higher-precision quant or when you disable prefetch?
Ravi: I tested: int8 -> no divergence. int4 repros reliably. Disable prefetch -> no repro. Disable streaming -> repro still happens. So prefetch + int4 is necessary in my runs.
Devon: That pattern suggests prefetch fills shadow entries and the packed int4 representation is introducing rounding that shifts RoPE phases across a modulus boundary at ~11k tokens.
Maya: Hypothesis: ahead-of-time KV assembly + int4 nibble packing changes rounding on the rotary multiply, causing a small phase slip that amplifies over layers.
Ravi: I uploaded dumps to s3: s3://redwood-dev/kvdumps/1718891010/sample.tar.gz (kv indexes, attn matrices, model hash).
Maya: Can you add the minimal text prompt? we need a deterministic minimal repro for CI.
Ravi: Minimal prompt used: `'A' * 11250 + '
Hello'` — reproduces reliably.
Devon: I'll add a small unit test that toggles prefetch window size and runs the headless reproduce to see the exact boundary where it starts.
Maya: Steps for triage: 1) confirm model weights hash, 2) dump KV pre/post around 11.2k, 3) run bisect disabling quantization packing stage, 4) check attn norm deltas per layer. Assigning to @Ravi to run steps 1-3 and @Devon to add the unit.
ci-bot: CI job triggered: `longstream-kv-bisect` (#184) — long job queued.
Ravi: Started long dumps, attachments in the s3 path above. Running bisect locally now — will push logs.
Devon: If bisect points to the quant packing, I can try a patched unpack that preserves rounding order and run a smoke.
Maya: Also capture `rotary_phase_snapshot` (we added that hook) at tokens 11250..11270.
Ravi: Snapshot added to the dump. Quick observed numbers: layer4_phase_delta=1.2e-3 layer10_phase_delta=4.7e-3 — seems to grow deeper.
Devon: That growth is consistent with a tiny per-layer multiplicative error. Could also be kernel reorder when prefetch interleaves memory copies.
Maya: If we don't have a clear fix in 48h escalate to eng-ml oncall. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Ravi: Will follow up with bisect results by EOD tomorrow.
Maya: Thanks — this is high priority for the magnet bring-up. :thumbsup:
Ravi: Updating thread: bisect found stage `int4_pack_nibbles` as the first-flaky change. Patch candidate in review.
Devon: Nice. After patch, run the streaming+prefetch job with the same minimal prompt and compare `attn_norm_post`.
Ravi: Ran patched build — no kv_index_mismatch and attn_norm_post now 0.9869 (close to pre). Pushing a canary build to dedicated for broader soak.
Maya: Great, keep the canary in monitored state for 24h then we can merge the guard.
Ravi: Copy. Closing here after soak.
